he.text: Continue from זְכוֹר רַחֲמֶיךָ page 164, till הָרַחֲמִים וְהַסְּלִיחוֹת page 167. The Reader says וְאַל יְעַכֵּב, and the Service is concluded as directed in page 167.

en.text: Say from “O Lord remember thy mercy,” page 164, till “mercy and pardon,” page 167. The Reader says “Let not sin,” &c., and the Service is concluded as directed in page 167.

editorial_expansion: Expand the bounded Monday closing reprints, then its Reader blessing and retained weekday performance rubric; omit fulfilled text-inclusion instructions.
